# OpenAPI 3.1 JSON Schema (2022-10-07)

`schema.json` is the OpenAPI Initiative's JSON Schema for OpenAPI 3.1.x documents (`$id`
`https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2022-10-07`), the file `schemas/v3.1/schema.json` of the
release tag `3.1.0-schemas` (commit `157a4c81ae537ef793b2bee368bc00d88b461de8`, "Publish v3.1
schemas version 2022-10-07") of the OAI/OpenAPI-Specification repository, from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/3.1.0-schemas/schemas/v3.1/schema.json
(SHA-256 `da01ba28852cac0de53893797cb8d1942bc3b05084f526dcc216717dec314ed0`). It is unchanged.

License: Apache-2.0 (the OpenAPI Specification repository's LICENSE, Copyright The Linux
Foundation).

The tests validate the Stolos Console's generated OpenAPI document (`GET /v1/openapi.json`, spec
094) against it with Ajv's JSON Schema draft 2020-12 build; it is not shipped in the engine.
